summary.name: TeamViewer
summary.one_liner: TeamViewer is a remote desktop and support platform for connecting to remote computers, providing remote support, and collaborating online.
use_cases: collaborate online with a remote team
summary.what_it_does: The page describes TeamViewer as a digital workplace platform for remote desktop access, remote support, and online collaboration. It offers add-ons to its TeamViewer Remote subscription for monitoring, managing, and protecting an IT environment. It also promotes Tia, an AI agent that learns from support sessions to predict and fix IT issues. Tia produces automated session summaries and helps build automations. The page text is mostly marketing and does not list specific features or pricing details.
notable: Tia AI agent that learns from support sessions and creates automated session summaries
Add-ons for monitoring, managing, and protecting IT systems on top of TeamViewer Remote subscription
Listed in awesome-mac under Remote Login Software
caveats: Add-ons require an enhancement to a TeamViewer Remote subscription
Page text does not confirm supported platforms or detailed pricing
